verdict.rationale: PayPal's REST APIs use client ID/secret OAuth token exchange (no interactive login), enabling fully headless, scriptable server-to-server calls suitable for CI automation, and PayPal provides a sandbox testing environment explicitly for automated/non-production testing plus an Agent Toolkit for programmatic function-calling integration. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented rate-limit/service-account guidance for automated test runs, and independent hands-on confirmation of running PayPal flows in a CI pipeline.
